description:
Update a customer subscription in PayPal.

This function updates an active or suspended subscription for a customer. It requires the subscription ID and payload of allowed keys to update to the subscription.
Required parameters are: subscription_id (the ID of the subscription to be updated), and at-least one key to update

Return response as structured JSON in your response.

Checked by fizzl-paypal-guard before it runs: the owner approves or denies each one.

auto_bill_outstanding.description: Indicates whether to automatically bill outstanding amounts.

custom_id.description: The custom id for the subscription

fixed_price.description: The fixed price for a billing cycle.

sequence.description: The order sequence for the billing cycles

value.description: The fixed price for the subscription.

payment_failure_threshold.description: The number of failed payments before the subscription is canceled.

address_line_1.description: The first line of the address.

address_line_2.description: The second line of the address.

shipping_amount.description: The value of the shipping amount.

subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription to update.

taxes_inclusive.description: Indicates whether the tax is inclusive.

name: update_subscription
